items.verbatim: WEDC Investor Tax Credit under the Qualified New Business Venture program, awarded 2023-07-06 to a recipient in City of Brookfield, Waukesha County. Industry: Professional Svcs (NAICS 541613). Award amount: $3,000,000. Planned project cost: $550,000.
